line.s_need.text: We need eight pebbles for hopscotch. I brought three.

line.s_have.text: And I have five in my basket. I counted them this morning.

line.s_naive.text: Then I will count them all from the start. One, two, three, four... Oh no, I got mixed up!

line.s_not.text: You do not have to start from one! We already know there are five in the basket.

line.s_on.text: From five! We count on. That is called counting on.

line.s_what.text: Counting on? Will you show me?

line.s_show.text: We keep five in our heads. Point to my pebbles one by one, and I will count on.

line.s_eight.text: Eight! And I did not have to count from the start.

line.s_solved.text: We have eight pebbles. Let's play hopscotch!

line.s_to_garden.text: Let's go to the garden. We will practise counting on there too.

line.b_basket.text: There are six carrots in the basket.

line.b_more.text: I pulled out two more. Let's count on!

line.b_count.text: Start from six. Point to the new carrots one by one.

line.b_pick.text: How many are there together? Point to the digit.

line.b_to_home.text: Let's go home. Guests are coming!

line.c_cups.text: There are seven cups in the box. The guests brought three more.

line.c_count.text: Let's count on from seven. Point to the new cups.

line.c_slot.text: Seven plus three equals what? Point to the number that fits at the end.

line.c_solved.text: Seven plus three is ten! Counting on is quick.

line.wrong_digit.text: That is another number. Count again.

line.p_intro.text: Let's play counting on! The box says how many are inside.

line.p_count_on.text: Start from the number on the box. Point to the new things one by one.

line.p_together.text: How many are there together? Point to the number.

line.a_game.text: Let's play counting on, just like at home.

line.a_ok.text: All right! We start from what we already know.

line.a_lyzka.text: There are five spoons in the drawer. Add these too. Count on from five.

line.a_klocek.text: There are six blocks in the box. Count on from six.

line.a_kubek.text: There are seven cups on the shelf. Count on from seven.

line.a_which_digit.text: How many are there together? Point to the number.

line.a_ask_parents.text: Ask your parents to count on with you. How many stairs will there be when you climb three more?
